name: j-future-foods
description: Shared author-guideline skill for KeAi/Tsinghua open-access food journals hosted on ScienceDirect: Journal of Future Foods (KeAi) and Food Science and Human Wellness (KeAi/Tsinghua). Use to format or check a manuscript for these journals — Elsevier-style structure, numbered references, and figure specs. Triggers: submit to Journal of Future Foods, Food Science and Human Wellness guidelines, KeAi food formatting. Also fires when the user wants to publish on/in this journal, format a manuscript for it, or match its reference/citation style.
